title: Routine Check
reference: F1 F1 F1 F1 def F1 { forward activate turn_right }
hints: Every corner has a switch, and every side ends at the next one. The sides are different lengths, but a slide does not care.
Teach F1 once: forward, activate, turn right. Main just calls it.
F1 F1 F1 F1 def F1 { forward activate turn_right }

story.intro: PATCH: "The Signal Hut. Radios, routines, and one very cold bot. Remember F1? Write a routine once, call it by name."
